title: Rust: ccp16-desync.json vector consumer + R-02a-079 FSM conformance tests (slice of b7z9.25)
description: Smallest Rust slice of b7z9.25 (decompose-first): no Rust consumer exists for test/vectors/ccp16-desync.json (only python/tests/test_ccp_sync_vector_consumers.py:290-386). Add a Rust consumer test in lichen-node (or lichen-core where the multi_instance/sfn FSMs live) driving the desync_on_sfn_wrap, multi_root_version_conflict_desync, excessive_clock_drift_desync, and desync_recovery_beacon_revalidate cases against lichen-rpl::multi_instance and the desync FSM, matching the python DesyncFSM oracle. C consumer already landed (lichen/tests/desync_fsm, bead b7z9.12.5).
